evidence.quote: Silicon & Precision: Xe 3P architecture, 32 Xe cores, 256 XMX engines; native FP4 to FP64 with full-rate double precision.
Memory & Platform: 160 GB LPDDR5X (1.5 TB/s bandwidth, scalable up to 480 GB); 350W PCIe 5.0 air-cooled form factor.
The GPU combines up to 480 GB of LPDDR5X memory, 1.5TB/s of memory bandwidth and 1.3 petaflops of FP8 compute to help improve the economics of sustained, memory-intensive AI inference.
supports models with up to 300 billion parameters on a single card and more than one trillion parameters in an eight-GPU system.

notes.zh:
回答「不想上机柜级液冷、又要在标准 PCIe 服务器里跑大显存推理，Intel 现在有什么卡」。D270 是 Intel 当前的数据中心推理 GPU：Xe3P、32 个 Xe core / 256 个 XMX、160GB LPDDR5X、1.5TB/s、350W、PCIe 5.0 风冷，原生 FP4 到 FP64；单卡可跑 300B 参数，8 卡可跑 1T+。它的差异点不是峰值算力，而是「大显存 + 低功耗 + 标准形态」。
不主张：480GB 是合作方配置，不是 Intel 品牌卡默认容量；1.3 PFLOPS 是 FP8，不是 FP4；单卡 300B / 8 卡 1T+ 是官方容量口径，不等于这些模型能以理想吞吐运行；官方给的性能对比基于 pre-production 芯片，属于厂商测试，不是独立实测；没有公开价格与正式上市日期。
notes.en:
Answers what Intel offers when a standard PCIe server must run large-memory inference without rack-level liquid cooling. D270 is Intel's current data-center inference GPU: Xe3P, 32 Xe cores / 256 XMX engines, 160 GB LPDDR5X at 1.5 TB/s, 350 W, PCIe 5.0 air-cooled, native FP4 through FP64; one card holds up to 300B parameters and eight cards more than 1T. Its differentiator is large memory plus low power in a standard form factor, not peak compute.
It does not claim: 480 GB is a partner configuration, not the default Intel-branded card; 1.3 PFLOPS is FP8, not FP4; the 300B / 1T+ figures are capacity statements, not a promise of ideal throughput; Intel's comparisons use pre-production silicon and are vendor tests, not independent measurements; no public price or general-availability date.
